gaps.quote: The bit procedure is built from a network of pointwise XOR gates
gaps.note: The page neither explains nor links 'bit procedure'; the reader knows only tape procedures.

gaps.quote: which updates one field by adding the other
gaps.note: The sentence is garbled ('since, and'), so the reader cannot see why an XOR network with frames on the address fields realises the bit procedure, or how the field update follows.
The edge operator is never defined. The reader must infer it as D_v D_u^{-1} from the stored arrays D_u g and D_v g before the product can telescope to the stated endpoint formula.

gaps.term: tape procedure is a scalar network
gaps.quote: Its construction chooses a scalar network that exchanges the two banks and restores the scratch values
gaps.note: The claim that every tape procedure is such a network rests on a construction the page never gives. 'Banks' of values is also undefined here, so the reader cannot check the claim.
Source and sink vertices are named but not explained or linked; the reader cannot tell what kind of vertex each is.
